Processed Biometric Data

The following special category personal data will be processed as part of the identity verification process:
• Your face image taken during the liveness test and the biometric photo on the chip of your identity card.

Purpose of Processing

This data is used solely for biometric matching to verify that the identity card belongs to you.

How It Is Processed

Your data is transmitted to our servers end-to-end encrypted (AES-256 + RSA-OAEP); the match is calculated only in the secure processing environment (AWS Nitro Enclave).

Not Stored and Deleted

Your biometric data is never recorded or stored. It is permanently deleted immediately after the match result is obtained. It is not shared with third parties.

Withdrawal of Consent

You can withdraw this consent at any time. If you withdraw your consent, operations requiring biometric verification cannot be performed.

A permanent recognition code unique to you

VerifyBlind creates a permanent recognition code unique to this organization. It is actually made of a few codes that work together, so the organization can reliably recognize you again:

• one from your ID number (if your ID has one),
• one from your name and birth details — unchanged even if you renew your card,
• one from your ID document — the same document means the same person.

Guarantees:
• Your ID number and identity details are NEVER shared — only irreversible codes are.
• The codes are unique to this organization; others cannot link you with them.
• Even if a country later adds or removes its ID number, or you renew your card, you can keep proving you are the same person.
